scripts.dev: (test -d artifacts/mobile/dist || npm run build --workspace=artifacts/mobile) && (test -d artifacts/admin-web/dist || npm run build --workspace=artifacts/admin-web) && npm run dev --workspace=artifacts/api-server
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace=artifacts/mobile && npm run build --workspace=artifacts/admin-web && npm run build --workspace=artifacts/api-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck --workspace=artifacts/api-server --workspace=scripts
